privacy: Explicit numeric/enum/file-name-and-hash allowlists; no operational paths, process IDs, environment values, certificate/key material, network addresses or raw payloads.
scope: Two completed current-epoch gRPC profiles covering four RPC modes; presentation extraction from completed execution/comparison metadata only.

interpretation.statistical_unit: Three independent processes per role per profile.
interpretation.latency_aggregation: Equal-weight process-metric means. Aggregate p50/p95/p99 are means of process percentiles, never pooled percentiles.
interpretation.noise: Original before-to-after process-mean decision only. Original direct-Rust arithmetic gaps have no separate noise decision in this reader. No p99/resource significance claim.
interpretation.throughput: Per-case successful rates use the whole mixed-profile measurement denominator; not isolated-case or capacity throughput. Calls, messages and payload bytes remain separate.
interpretation.rss: Headline RSS is the maximum of process peak RSS values. Original mean-of-process-peaks is separately retained.
interpretation.resources: Whole mixed-profile CPU/RSS/allocation/gauges; never assigned to a case.
interpretation.allocation: GC.GetTotalAllocatedBytes(false), partial measurement bracket, not exact bytes/call. Direct Rust managed-GC is null.
interpretation.gauges: Sampled observations, not exact byte high-water marks or transfer totals. Actual after-idle counters retained per process.
interpretation.compression: Selected product guide implements identity payload compression only. The comparison supplies no per-request negotiated-compression flag and establishes no network compression benefit.
interpretation.correctness: Original correctness-failure counters, client/controller outcomes, GrpcOK status counts and eligibility are retained. Separate protobuf/hash/trailer verification flags are not present in this comparison metadata and are not invented.
interpretation.encoded_bytes: Literal encoded protobuf byte counters; these do not quantify HTTP/2 framing/TLS overhead or establish compression. A response payload count can be zero while encoded metadata fields are nonzero.
interpretation.credit: No new execution, statistical, capacity, long-duration or B18 semantic acceptance credit.
interpretation.separate_failure: SQLite C16 remains unaccepted. The observed gRPC server-stream mean regression is retained for the task owner.
interpretation.concurrency: Configured concurrency is four. The comparison does not report an independently measured simultaneous HTTP/2 stream count.
interpretation.deadline_and_cancel: These ordinary comparisons have no expected-probe rows. Recorded intentional deadline/cancellation counts are zero; these are counts, not fresh semantic or post-cancellation release acceptance.
